ideas.name: Monthly Currency Carry Portfolios
ideas.claim: Sort currencies by one-month forward discount, buy the highest-interest-rate portfolio and sell the lowest-interest-rate portfolio.
ideas.quote: Investors earn the carry trade premium by shorting baskets of low interest rate currencies and going long in baskets of high interest rate currencies.

rules.market: Currencies against USD, including a developed-country sample; the paper also studies a broader sample.
rules.entry: At month-end, sort currencies into six portfolios by forward discount; go long the highest-interest-rate portfolio and short the lowest.
rules.exit: Rebalance portfolios at the end of every month.
rules.filters: Include currencies with available spot and forward rates; the paper also excludes specified observations with large covered-interest-parity failures.

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports a spread in average excess returns between high- and low-interest-rate currency portfolios.
